One independent complete game WALK sprite, SOUTHWEST camera. Rotate the ENTIRE character coherently to face diagonally DOWN-LEFT, FRONT-LEFT THREE-QUARTER. Nose, eyes, chest, pelvis and both boots all aim down-left together. Both eyes visible but far eye narrower. This is not front view and not left side profile, about 45 degrees from frontal. Walk frame01 left anatomical leg reaches down-left in heel contact; right leg trails up-right with grounded toe, both knees articulated and both boots visible. Preserve full star girl identity: long dark hair in high half-up bun, red-gold star crown and small forehead star, warm smiling face, black-red-ivory-gold robes, star belt and complete black-gold boots. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the complete original round black-gold astrolabe, anatomical LEFT hand holds exactly THREE physical star cards. Do not switch hands. Hair, robes, tassels modest walking secondary motion; stable head and torso proportions. No cape added.
Native full single square frame >=1024, genuinely transparent alpha, whole figure and all equipment within generous margins; x512 body axis, supporting foot baseline y942 normalized to1024. Fixed camera and bright soft painted lighting. No background/shadow/checkerboard, no particles or magical glow, no text or panels, no colored fringe, no extra body parts.
